# shipd_project_access_grant (Resource)

Manages one direct member grant or team assignment in a shipd project. Use a service-account token with project_access:read for import and refresh and project_access:manage for writes. Each project and principal pair should have a single Terraform resource. Removing the final team assignment restores organization-wide project access under shipd's normal authorization rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_project_access_grant" "reviewer" {
  project_id     = "project-id"
  principal_type = "member"
  principal_id   = "organization-membership-id"
  role           = "viewer"
}

resource "shipd_project_access_grant" "release_team" {
  project_id     = "project-id"
  principal_type = "team"
  principal_id   = "team-id"
  role           = "editor"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) Existing organization membership ID for a member, or team ID for a team.
- `principal_type` (String) Principal type, either member or team.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `role` (String) Project role, either viewer or editor. Use inherited for a team assignment whose role follows shipd's organization-role inheritance rules.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grant ID in the format PROJECT_ID/PRINCIPAL_TYPE/PRINCIPAL_ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_project_access_grant.reviewer PROJECT_ID/member/MEMBER_ID
terraform import shipd_project_access_grant.release_team PROJECT_ID/team/TEAM_ID
```
